one_line: Kakatiya ruler whose 1163 CE Anumakonda inscription marks the family’s rise from Rashtrakuta-linked feudatories to sovereigns in the Telangana heartland.

appearance.age_look: early 30s, lean but strongly built, athletic warrior-king
appearance.face: oval face with medium-brown Deccan complexion, straight nose, sharp jawline, neatly trimmed moustache and short beard along the chin, expressive large anime-style eyes with a calm determined gaze, default expression serious yet approachable with a hint of strategic focus
appearance.hair: thick black hair tied into a high, compact topknot at the crown, wrapped with a narrow dark maroon cloth band, small gold stud earrings at each ear, no crown but a simple gold forehead chain resting above the brows with a central round pendant
appearance.costume: era-accurate late 11th–12th century Deccan royal-warrior attire: a fitted short-sleeved anga (tunic) of deep indigo cotton reaching mid-thigh, bordered at the sleeves and hem with narrow maroon and gold bands; over this, a diagonally-draped ochre-yellow cotton sash from left shoulder to right hip, tied securely and falling in pleats; a long off-white dhoti of sturdy cotton wrapped firmly around the waist and legs, pleated in front and brought between the legs in a warrior’s style allowing movement, its border in muted maroon; a plain leather waist-belt in dark brown holding a small utilitarian pouch; simple but dignified jewellery—two thin gold bangles on each wrist, a modest gold necklace with a small circular pendant, and an armlet on the right upper arm shaped like a stylised sun-disc nodding to later panegyric without grandiose emphasis; bare but fully covered torso under garments, and feet in brown leather sandals appropriate to Deccan terrain; textiles appear handwoven with subtle linear weave texture, no flashy patterns beyond the borders.
appearance.signature: a straight double-edged iron sword inspired by early Deccan katti forms, with a slightly flared, utilitarian cross-guard, simple dark wood hilt bound with leather, and a plain iron scabbard hanging from his belt on the left hip, always carried at his side or lightly gripped in one hand.

ref_desc: Rudradeva appears as a lean medium-brown Deccan warrior-king with a high black topknot, indigo tunic, off-white dhoti, ochre sash, modest gold ornaments, brown sandals, and a plain iron-sheathed sword at his left hip in an indigo-maroon-ochre palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Rudradeva of Anumakonda: an early-30s, lean but strong Deccan ruler with medium-brown skin, oval face, sharp jaw, straight nose, neatly trimmed moustache and short chin beard, and large serious yet approachable eyes. His thick black hair is tied in a compact high topknot wrapped with a narrow dark maroon cloth band, with a simple gold forehead chain and small gold stud earrings. He wears a deep indigo short-sleeved tunic with maroon and gold borders at the sleeves and hem, an ochre-yellow sash draped diagonally from left shoulder to right hip, and a long off-white dhoti wrapped firmly around waist and legs in a warrior’s style, bordered in muted maroon. A dark brown leather belt with a small pouch circles his waist, and he has modest gold jewellery: thin bangles on each wrist, a small round-pendant necklace, and a single sun-disc armlet on his right upper arm. His feet are in brown leather sandals, and he carries a straight double-edged iron sword with simple flared guard, dark wood hilt, and plain iron scabbard hanging from his left hip. Show him from head to toe with consistent colors—deep indigo, maroon, ochre yellow, off-white, and dark brown—and multiple angles or poses that clearly display his face, topknot, clothing layers, jewellery, sandals, and sword as a coherent, repeatable design.
